title: The Roman temple at Baia, Italy
medium: Pen and grey ink and grey wash over traces of pencil

events.n: Towne's visit to Baia with Thomas Jones (with Jones on 19 March 1781; Jones's notebook gives Baia on 20 March), where the original was drawn
events.q: Towne was with Thomas Jones, who acted as his guide to the city, on 19 March 1781, although Jones’s notebook records their visit to Baia on 20 March.

events.n: copy after Francis Towne (1739-1816) by his best-known pupil
events.q: This is a copy after Francis Towne (1739-1816) by his best-known pupil

events.n: the Towne original this copies, purchased from Spink in 1947; not this work
events.q: The Towne, which is executed in brown and grey washes, is now in the collection of the Graves Art Gallery, Sheffield, purchased from Spink in 1947.
Spink, English Watercolour Drawings Annual Exhibition 1982, no. 8
By descent in the family of the artist until 1981

events.n: sold by Spink to Anthony Mould
events.q: sold to Anthony Mould on 29 April 1982
